verdict: Paid ads are off; organic is holding but showing early cracks.
narrative: There was zero paid spend and zero paid leads this period — all activity came through your Google Business Profile and organic search. Your GBP delivered 178 actions over the 28 days, including 61 calls, but that channel dropped sharply in the final week, with GBP activity down 59% and search clicks down 23% versus the prior 7 days, including three consecutive days of zero GBP actions at month-end. Paid campaigns will resume once the contract extension is signed, which is the single step gating the next phase of activity. In the meantime, a posting cadence for your GBP is being put in place to stabilize that visibility before it slides further.
